description: Baseline benchmark for WRLD-01. These prompts serve as quality anchors — run them against future model versions to measure improvement. Each entry records the style mode, complexity tier, and what quality dimension it tests.

styles.default: Rich gradients, editorial illustration style, atmospheric scenes
styles.flat-icon: Dark background, bold neon fills, pure vector, no gradients or blur
styles.holographic: Cream background, mesh gradients, 3D depth via radial highlights

prompts.tests: Primary shape clarity, color choice, centering, minimal composition
Geometric precision, badge proportions, symbol-inside-shape legibility

prompts.prompt: a space rocket launching with flames
prompts.tests: Multi-element flat composition, fire/smoke as pure shapes, vertical energy

prompts.prompt: a retro cassette tape with equalizer bars
prompts.tests: Y2K aesthetic execution, fine detail at flat style, nostalgia palette

prompts.prompt: a floating sphere with iridescent surface
prompts.tests: 3D illusion via gradients, highlight placement, ambient glow
Smooth bezier curves, mesh gradient transitions, fluid organic feel

prompts.prompt: a glass pill capsule with colorful liquid inside
prompts.tests: Transparency illusion, layered depth, refraction-style gradient

prompts.prompt: a floating crystal cluster on a light background
prompts.tests: Multi-facet gradients, editorial composition, premium feel

prompts.prompt: a mountain peak at golden hour
prompts.tests: Atmospheric color, horizon depth, gradient sky

prompts.prompt: a coffee cup on a wooden desk with morning light coming through a window
prompts.tests: Scene composition, light source consistency, material texture via gradients

prompts.prompt: a futuristic city skyline at night with neon reflections in rain puddles
prompts.tests: Multi-layer complexity, reflection rendering, atmospheric depth, layer organization

scoring_guide: Score each dimension 1-5. A baseline WRLD-01 score is recorded here as a reference point for future WRLD-01.1+ improvements. Higher versions should show measurable gains in color_harmony and visual_craft first.
notes: To regenerate benchmarks, run each prompt through /api/svg/generate with the specified style and save the SVG output alongside this file as wrld-01-outputs/. When releasing WRLD-01.1, add a wrld-011-baseline.json and include before/after comparisons in the changelog.
